newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Mobutu appoints general as new prime minister.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu appoints general as new prime minister.

text.p: Zaire's President Mobutu Sese Seko appointed a senior general as prime minister on Wednesday, effectively replacing newly appointed prime minister Etienne Tshisekedi.

State television, quoting a decree signed by the president, reported that General Likulia Bolongo had been appointed under emergency powers. He was defence minister in the government of prime minister Kengo wa Dondo, whom Tshesekedi replaced.

The television said that Mobutu named a new prime minister because Zaire's political family had withdrawn its support for opposition veteran Tshisekedi, a Mobutu foe appointed to the post only last week.
Earlier on Wednesday, thousands of Tshisekedi supporters clashed with security forces in Kinshasa as he tried to make his way to the prime minister's offices to install his new government.
A Tshisekedi aide said that soldiers had escorted the radical leader back home. He was bleeding from a wound to the head, the aide added.

Tshisekedi fell foul of Mobutu supporters and allies alike after announcing a government composed only of his most loyal followers. He earmaked six posts for rebels, who took up arms in October vowing to topple Mobutu and who hold nearly half of the country. The offer was rebuffed. REUTER STR NJP
